popCulture.title: Troilus and Cressida
popCulture.creator: William Shakespeare
popCulture.description: Shakespeare's bitter Trojan comedy made Troilus the betrayed lover — medieval romance grafted onto the Iliad's doomed prince.

popCulture.title: Troilus
popCulture.description: Achilles' ambush of the young Trojan at the fountain remains vase-painting's favourite Troilus scene — youth cut down before the war's end.
